title: Automatic Transmission Disassembly
introduction: I start with the matching overhaul instructions before the first bolt gets its moment in the spotlight. This entry directs transmission disassembly to that procedure. The procedure is unavailable here, so preparation, equipment, disassembly order and required checks remain unresolved. This page cannot serve as standalone disassembly instructions.

items.name: Transmission overhaul procedure
items.detail: Obtain the linked overhaul procedure before beginning disassembly.

edits.text: To disassemble the transmission, use the transmission overhaul procedure. Refer to: [Transmission (307-01 Automatic Transmission - 6-Speed Automatic Transmission – 6R80, Overhaul)](#/document/G1692066).
edits.why: The matching overhaul procedure must establish how the unit comes apart and which checks accompany the work. This referral supplies no component-removal sequence.
